test_title: PYST 53: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Identify from the given options the word most similar in meaning to the underlined word according to its meaning in the following sentence.

He is a person who holds __old fashioned__ opinions.
solution:
The correct answer is Option (1) i.e. Obsolete.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Old-fashioned** : (पुराने ढंग का) - Outdated or not in style anymore.

 
 
• **Example**: Her old-fashioned dress stood out at the modern art exhibit.
 
 
 
• **Obsolete **: (अप्रचलित) - No longer produced or used; out of date.
 
 
• **Example**: Floppy disks have become obsolete.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is Obsolete.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ancient **: (प्राचीन) - Belonging to the very distant past and no longer in existence.

 
 
• **Example**: The ruins of ancient civilizations fascinate archaeologists.
 
 
 
• **Antique **: (प्राचीन वस्तु) - Having a high value because of considerable age.
 
 
• **Example**: She collects antique furniture.
 
 
 
• **Senior Citizen** : (वरिष्ठ नागरिक) - An older person, typically over the age of 60 or 65, especially one who is retired.
 
 
• **Example**: Senior citizens receive discounts at the museum.
